prompt: This photograph captures a serene and mystical scene of a lone rider on a camel traversing the Giza Plateau in Egypt. The image features a minimalist, almost monochromatic color palette dominated by soft pastels. The sky is a pale lavender, blending seamlessly into the misty horizon, creating a dreamy, ethereal atmosphere. The rider, positioned slightly to the right of the center, is dressed in traditional Bedouin attire: a long, flowing white robe and a turban. The camel, with its humped back and long neck, is also dressed in a similar white garment, blending with the desert landscape. The foreground is a smooth, sandy expanse, devoid of vegetation, with gentle undulations. The background showcases the iconic pyramids of Giza, their sharp edges softened by the mist, creating a sense of distance and depth. The light in the image is diffused, with rays of sunlight piercing through the mist, casting a soft glow on the sand and the rider. The overall composition is calm and contemplative, emphasizing the solitude and grandeur of the ancient Egyptian landscape. --ar 3:4 --style raw --profile d7ov5hs --stylize 450 --v 7
